create_vertex_embedder: create a VertexDirectEmbedder with a given number of vertices and embedding dimensions
reset_embedder_parameters: reset the VertexDirectEmbedder embeddings to zero using reset_parameters
get_normalized_embeddings: get normalized vertex embeddings tensor by calling forward on the embedder
load_embeddings_from_file: load precomputed vertex embeddings from a pickle file into the embedder
build_vertex_embedding_module: build a PyTorch nn.Module that produces normalized vertex embeddings for DensePose CSE
